einvoicing.needsLinkBody: The connection dropped while sending, and {provider} now says it already holds an e-invoice with this number. It may have been delivered and reported, so it is not sent again and is not shown as rejected. Find the document in {provider}'s portal and link it to this invoice.
einvoicing.block_no_provider: Generated and validated — not sent. No e-invoicing provider is connected.
einvoicing.block_test_provider: Test mode: a built-in test provider answers. Nothing is sent to your customer or the FTA.
einvoicing.block_legal_entity_not_active: Generated and validated — not sent. Finish connecting your e-invoicing provider in EmaraTax first.
einvoicing.block_legal_entity_delinked: Not sent: your e-invoicing provider was removed in EmaraTax. Link it again to send.
einvoicing.reportingNotRequiredHint: Sales to individuals are not reported in this phase
einvoicing.issuesTitle: Not ready for e-invoicing: {count} to fix
einvoicing.issue_buyerEndpointMissing: The buyer has no electronic address for the e-invoice. Add the customer's 15-digit TRN to the invoice or the customer, or record the customer's Peppol endpoint (scheme 0235 with its 10-digit TIN, or its own Peppol scheme and ID).
einvoicing.issue_buyerAddressMissing: The customer's address is incomplete for the e-invoice. Open the customer and fill in the street address, the city and the emirate, then check the invoice again.
einvoicing.fixStepCorrect: Correct the invoice where the reason points.
einvoicing.fixStepCheckBuyer: Check the customer's TRN and e-invoicing address.
einvoicing.fixStepResubmit: Resubmit: the same e-invoice is sent again with your corrections.
einvoicing.resubmitBlocked: Fix the items above first, then resubmit.
einvoicing.loadFailed: Could not load the e-invoice status.
einvoicing.sheetDescription: Delivery to your customer and reporting to the FTA are tracked separately.
einvoicing.historyDescription: Every validation, hand-off and status change, newest first.
einvoicing.err_unknown: The provider did not give a reason.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_PROVIDER_NOT_CON: No e-invoicing provider is connected, so nothing was sent.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_LEGAL_ENTITY_NOT: Connect this company to your e-invoicing provider in EmaraTax before sending.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_LEGAL_ENTITY_DEL: Your e-invoicing provider is no longer linked to this company in EmaraTax. Link it again to send.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_SUPPLIER_ENDPOIN: Your e-invoicing address on the invoice does not match the TIN linked at your provider.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_VALIDATION_FAILE: Some details the FTA requires are missing.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_TIN_MISSING: Add your 15-digit TRN in company settings first; its first 10 digits are your TIN.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_LEGAL_ENTITY_NOT: Start the connection with your provider first.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_VALIDATION: A-Cube found a problem in the e-invoice and did not send it.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_BAD_REQUEST: A-Cube could not read the e-invoice.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_LEGAL_ENTITY_NOT_FO: A-Cube does not know this supplier yet. Check that the company is connected.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_AUTH_FAILED: Muhasib could not sign in to A-Cube. It will retry; contact support if this persists.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_UNAVAILABLE: A-Cube is not reachable right now. It will be retried automatically.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_SENDING_FAILED: A-Cube could not send the e-invoice over Peppol.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_DELIVERY_FAILED: The customer's provider could not receive the e-invoice. Check the customer's e-invoicing address.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_ACTION_REQUIRED: A-Cube needs an action on this document. Check it with A-Cube support.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_UNKNOWN_STATUS: A-Cube reported a status Muhasib does not recognise; it is shown as failed until checked.
einvoicing.err_ACUBE_NO_DOCUMENT_ID: A-Cube accepted the request but returned no document to track. It will be retried.
einvoicing.err_TRANSPORT_ERROR: The connection to the provider dropped. It is retried automatically and never sent twice.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_VALIDATION: The e-invoicing provider found a problem in the e-invoice and did not send it.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_DELIVERY_FAILED: The e-invoice could not be delivered to the customer. Check the customer's e-invoicing address.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_NEEDS_LINK: The provider may already hold this e-invoice after a lost response. Link its document to this invoice; it is not sent again.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_REPORT_FAILED: The tax data could not be reported to the FTA.
einvoicing.acubeDescription: A-Cube is an accredited e-invoicing service provider. It sends your e-invoices to your customers over Peppol and reports the tax data to the FTA.
einvoicing.acubeNotConnectedTitle: A-Cube is not connected on this account
einvoicing.acubeNotConnectedBody: E-invoices are generated and validated here, but nothing is sent until an A-Cube account is connected. Request the connection and our team will set it up with you.
einvoicing.corner2Body: Checks it and sends it on.
einvoicing.corner5Body: A-Cube reports the invoice's tax data to the FTA. You cannot connect to Peppol on your own: an accredited provider is required.
einvoicing.stepReserveBody: This tells A-Cube to expect your company. Nothing is sent yet.
einvoicing.stepApproveBody: Only the taxpayer can appoint a provider. Whoever signs in to EmaraTax for the company does this, with UAE PASS.
einvoicing.stepSyncedBody: A-Cube registers your e-invoicing address and syncs with the FTA's registry. Sending starts from your go-live date.
einvoicing.tinMissing: add your TRN in company settings
einvoicing.approverEmailHelp: We note who is expected to approve, so your team knows whom to ask.
einvoicing.emaraStep1: Sign in to EmaraTax with UAE PASS and open the company's taxable person.
einvoicing.emaraStep2: Open E-Invoicing, then the list of providers for onboarding.
einvoicing.emaraStep4: Continue to A-Cube and confirm the company details within five minutes.
einvoicing.reservationExpires: The reservation lasts until {date}; reserving again renews it.
einvoicing.delinkedBody: A-Cube was removed as the company's provider in EmaraTax. Sending is blocked until it is linked again.
einvoicing.goLive: Your go-live date (confirm for your entity)
einvoicing.registerLink: View on the Ministry of Finance register
einvoicing.band_large: Revenue of AED 50 million or more
einvoicing.timelineSource: Per the published Ministry of Finance timeline (Ministerial Decisions 243 and 244 of 2025). These dates are for guidance only: confirm the dates that apply to your entity on mof.gov.ae or with your adviser.
einvoicing.reportWindowAssumption: Reporting window: {days} days after the invoice date. This is a configurable assumption, not a confirmed FTA rule. Confirm it with the FTA or A-Cube before relying on a report-by date.
einvoicing.scopeB2b: Invoices to businesses (B2B) and government (B2G) are delivered and reported.
einvoicing.scopeB2c: Sales to individuals (B2C) are not in scope yet: they are booked as usual without e-invoicing.
einvoicing.scopeCreditNotes: Credit notes are e-invoices in their own right: sent and reported like invoices.
einvoicing.scopeVoid: A sent e-invoice cannot be cancelled; correct it with a credit note.
einvoicing.headerIssueOne: {field} is needed before this e-invoice can be sent.
einvoicing.headerIssueMany: {field} and {count} more items are needed before this e-invoice can be sent.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_VALIDATION: Complyance found a problem in the e-invoice and did not send it.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_DUPLICATE_NUMB: Complyance already holds an invoice with this number, so nothing was sent twice. Link it from the Complyance Invoice Portal, or issue a credit note and a new invoice.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_XML_FAILED: Complyance could not produce the e-invoice. Contact support with the invoice number.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_BAD_REQUEST: Complyance could not read the e-invoice.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_SOURCE_NOT_FOU: Complyance does not recognise this company's invoice source. Check the connection in settings.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_SOURCE_AMBIGUO: Complyance has two invoice sources with this company's name. Ask support to archive the duplicate.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_SOURCE_MISSING: Finish connecting this company to Complyance before sending.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_MAPPING_NOT_RE: Complyance is not ready to take this company's invoices yet: its required test cases have not all passed.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_AUTH_FAILED: Muhasib could not authenticate with Complyance. It will retry; contact support if this persists.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_RATE_LIMITED: Complyance asked us to slow down. It will be retried automatically.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_UNAVAILABLE: Complyance is not reachable right now. It will be retried automatically.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_NO_DOCUMENT_ID: Complyance accepted the request but returned no document to track. It will be retried.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_DELIVERY_FAILE: The customer's provider could not receive the e-invoice. Check the customer's e-invoicing address.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_FINAL_INVALID: The customer's provider rejected the e-invoice. This number cannot be sent again: issue a credit note and a new invoice.
einvoicing.err_COMPLYANCE_UNKNOWN_STATE: Complyance reported a status Muhasib does not recognise; it is shown as failed until checked.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_NEW_DOCUMENT_REQ: This invoice number cannot be sent again. Issue a credit note and a new invoice.
einvoicing.err_EINVOICE_LINK_MISMATCH: That Complyance document is not this invoice.
einvoicing.resubmitNewDocument: This number is used up at the provider. Issue a credit note and a new invoice instead.
einvoicing.providerCardDescription: An accredited e-invoicing service provider sends your e-invoices to your customers over Peppol and reports the tax data to the FTA.
einvoicing.providerNotConnectedBody: E-invoices are generated and validated here, but nothing is sent or reported until an accredited provider is connected. Request the connection and our team will set it up with you.
einvoicing.corner5BodyNeutral: Your provider reports the invoice's tax data to the FTA. You cannot connect to Peppol on your own: an accredited provider is required.
einvoicing.corner5BodyProvider: {provider} reports the invoice's tax data to the FTA. You cannot connect to Peppol on your own: an accredited provider is required.
einvoicing.providerAccreditedBody: Only providers on the Ministry of Finance register can send UAE e-invoices.
einvoicing.reportWindowAssumptionNeutral: Reporting window: {days} days after the invoice date. This is a configurable assumption, not a confirmed FTA rule. Confirm it with the FTA or your provider before relying on a report-by date.
einvoicing.reportWindowAssumptionProvide: Reporting window: {days} days after the invoice date. This is a configurable assumption, not a confirmed FTA rule. Confirm it with the FTA or {provider} before relying on a report-by date.
einvoicing.cmpDescription: Complyance is an accredited e-invoicing service provider. It sends your e-invoices to your customers over Peppol and reports the tax data to the FTA.
einvoicing.cmpStepRequestBody: Enter the administrator email that authorises Complyance in EmaraTax. Complyance checks your TIN and this email with EmaraTax. Nothing is sent yet.
einvoicing.cmpStepAuthorizeBody: Only the taxpayer can appoint a provider. The company's administrator does this in EmaraTax with UAE PASS, using the email above.
einvoicing.cmpStepReadyBody: Complyance registers your company and its e-invoicing address and confirms it is ready for invoicing. Sending starts from your go-live date.
einvoicing.cmpAdminEmailHelp: Use the email the EmaraTax authorisation is registered with; a different email will not match.
einvoicing.cmpEmaraStep4: Authorise it with the administrator email above, then come back and check the status.
einvoicing.cmpAwaitingAuth: Complyance has not found the EmaraTax authorisation yet. Muhasib checks again every 10 minutes.
einvoicing.cmpMappingPending: Registered at Complyance. Complyance has not yet confirmed the company is ready for invoicing.
einvoicing.cmpInactive: The company's Complyance source is inactive. Sending is blocked until it is active again.
einvoicing.taxId.cardDescription: The seller details every UAE e-invoice carries: your TIN, an official ID and a full address.
einvoicing.taxId.legalNameHelp: As it appears on your trade licence.
einvoicing.taxId.arabicHelp: Shown on Arabic and bilingual invoices.
einvoicing.taxId.tinHelp: 10 digits starting with 1: the first 10 digits of your Corporate Tax TRN.
einvoicing.taxId.tinPrefilled: Filled in from your {source}. Check it, then save.
einvoicing.taxId.tinFormatError: The TIN is 10 digits and starts with 1.
einvoicing.taxId.tinCtMismatch: This TIN does not match the first 10 digits of your Corporate Tax TRN.
einvoicing.taxId.tinVatMismatch: This TIN does not match the first 10 digits of your VAT TRN.
einvoicing.taxId.idPassportFormat: A passport number is 6 to 12 letters or digits.
einvoicing.taxId.authorityHelp: For example the Department of Economy and Tourism, Dubai, or a free zone authority.
einvoicing.taxReady.title: Add your e-invoice details
einvoicing.taxReady.body: UAE e-invoices carry a few seller details. {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} still missing. Add them once and every invoice uses them.
einvoicing.taxReady.addArabic: Also add the Arabic legal name and address
einvoicing.taxReady.whereLater: You can change these any time in Settings, Company.
einvoicing.appoint.partnerUnknown: the accredited service provider the company chose
einvoicing.appoint.step1: Sign in to EmaraTax with the account that manages {company}'s tax registration.
einvoicing.appoint.step2: Open the e-invoicing section and choose to appoint an accredited service provider.
einvoicing.appoint.step3: Find {partner} in the list and select it.
einvoicing.appoint.step4: Review the request and approve it.
einvoicing.appoint.step5: Come back here and verify the connection.
einvoicing.appoint.step5Done: Come back to this page and press Done.
einvoicing.appoint.menuNote: Menu names in EmaraTax can change. If a step looks different, look for the e-invoicing service provider option.
einvoicing.appoint.pageIntro: {company} asked you to approve its e-invoicing partner in EmaraTax. You do not need an account here.
einvoicing.appoint.pageIntroNamed: {name}, {company} asked you to approve its e-invoicing partner in EmaraTax. You do not need an account here.
einvoicing.appoint.doneFailed: We could not record that. Try again in a moment.
einvoicing.appoint.doneThanks: Thank you. {company} has been told, and will verify the connection with its partner.
einvoicing.appoint.invalidBody: Check that you opened the whole link from the message you received.
einvoicing.appoint.goneBody: Ask the person who sent it for a new link.
einvoicing.appoint.pageFooter: This page only shows the approval steps. It gives no access to the company's books.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.title: Your e-invoicing partner
einvoicing.partnerChoice.description: UAE e-invoices go through an accredited service provider (ASP) on the Ministry of Finance register. Choose yours, appoint it in EmaraTax, then verify the link.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.noDefault: We do not pick one for you. Nothing is sent until your partner is connected.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.state_self_conf: Confirmed by you, not yet verified
einvoicing.partnerChoice.detailsMissing: {count, plural, one {# detail is} other {# details are}} missing.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.linkIntro: Create a private link for the person who signs in to EmaraTax. It shows only the steps and your company name, works for 14 days and can be withdrawn.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.linkEmailHelp: Optional. When email is set up, we send them the link.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.linkCreated: Link ready. Send it to them yourself.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.linkCreatedEmai: Link ready and queued for email. You can also send it yourself.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.linkShownOnce: For safety we show this link only once.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.verifyUnavailab: {partner} is not connected to this workspace yet, so we cannot check the appointment with them.
einvoicing.partnerChoice.selfConfirmedOn: Confirmed by you on {date}, not yet verified
einvoicing.partnerChoice.transmissionOff: E-invoices are not sent from this workspace until the partner is connected and verified.
einvoicing.taxId.passportCountryHelp: 2-letter country code, for example AE, IN or GB.
einvoicing.taxId.idPassportCountry: Enter the 2-letter code of the country that issued the passport.
